evidence: Source review of the combined native Mac delivery and small-faults base d4bbc27c: native Ticket, conversation, deployment, health, and error response fields remain readable by build 1. No owner authentication rule, executor protocol, or native model changes. Native previews retain the registry and proxy payloads, with named Home eligibility internal to the service. Native resource measurements retain the existing Measurement and Sample contracts. The watchdog observation timestamp is private receipt metadata; grace changes alarm timing only. Mac log truncation retains the cleanup result schema. Auxiliary jobs retain the six-key installation identity and required path/environment bindings. Incoming provider discovery preserves host Node priority and feeds the same environment to all four install jobs. Incoming Darwin process caching leaves the shared BSD structure unchanged. Small-faults restart, cleanup, held-message, and retention repairs retain public payloads and native build floor. The incoming base records passing full local suites and strict mypy. Integration rechecks pass 13 Mac install cases and mypy for the four relevant modules. Earlier feature full-suite and affected-revision evidence is retained in the Ticket; no unchanged full suite repeated. This is source compatibility evidence only. Actual native Mac execution, physical sleep/login, launchd file behavior, processor cost, signed-device iOS, TestFlight, and the later combined installation check remain not tested. Final install-and-join integration review against native build 1 after feature/home-setup 545cb846e: existing native owner APIs and response models retain their fields. The packaged Mac installer reuses canonical maintenance and watchdog definitions and includes their collision checks, login links, startup and cleanup. Provider discovery and Homebrew Node precedence remain intact. The bootstrap forwards one SIGINT to a separate child session and waits for rollback without changing runtime or native contracts. Name-only join issuance reuses the existing machine owner API; the executor authenticates its platform later. No native build-floor, draft, outbox, APNs or authentication change follows from these installer changes. Final local checks pass: 2143 unit, 152 integration, 28 E2E and all 13 browser cases, plus 1119 frontend runtime and 62 companion tests, full mypy and generated contracts. The real child process regression proves delayed interrupt cleanup. The Manager transfers combined VPS/Linux registration proof to the Linux executor Consequences and combined check. Native Mac execution, launcher replacement permission continuity, signed-device and TestFlight behavior remain not tested. This is source compatibility evidence, not native release certification.
